Police say group seized store in city of Cartagena and local media showed footage of snipers on nearby buildings

A group of armed men with their faces covered seized a supermarket in the Colombian city of Cartagena on Tuesday and are holding an unknown number of people hostage, Colombian police said.

Footage shared on social media showed dozens of people rushing out of the Exito supermarket in Cartagena’s La Castellana neighborhood, while local media have shown footage of snipers on nearby buildings in what appears to be a standoff between the armed men and police.
